observations: No legacy script, test, launcher, database, process, port, browser profile, cache, credential file, or maintenance command was executed, attached to, stopped, reused, read, or modified.
Candidate discovery read only explicit immutable acquisition or result JSON files and local images. The legacy SQLite database and its WAL and SHM files were not opened.
No Chengfeng host, login, cookie, signed URL, request, response, browser profile, platform read, or platform write was used.
No cloud OCR, local CPU OCR, local GPU OCR, template matching, or platform expected weight was used to select or label a candidate.

The candidate tool refuses discovery JSON, selection JSON, contact-sheet, and staged-package outputs inside the legacy root or a resolved symlink or junction into that root before source reads or filesystem writes.
The candidate package is stored in a separate local application-data root and contains content-addressed copies, de-identified waybill identities, source hashes, and no preselected human truth.
Review mode cannot be combined with template tuning, test fixtures, OCR composition, or ordinary application jobs. It exposes no ordinary job write route and starts no scheduler.
Review writes require the local session, CSRF token, same origin, idempotency key, and expected record version. Versions are append-only and an idempotency replay returns the exact historical result.
Candidate clues are a fixed allowlist, collapsed by default, and described as non-authoritative. Upload slot, OCR result, platform value, and legacy result cannot become human truth.
The final browser run sent no POST request. The final review database contained zero review and idempotency records.
The temporary browser and local review server were closed. Port 8877 had no listener after validation.
All project Python commands used the project .venv. Windows DNS, proxy, VPN, routing, hosts files, browser defaults, GPU drivers, and system Python were not modified.
release_limit: The package is awaiting direct human review. Candidate clues cannot prove swapped, same-role, duplicate-upload, unknown-layout, non-ticket, or image-quality truth.
